body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes Markdown-formatted content on the CRM Help page rendering as plain text by switching the page schema to use the already-available `markdown` component and ensuring the markdown plugin is registered in the console test environment.

**Changes:**
- Update CRM Help page schema to render its content via a single `type: 'markdown'` component (instead of multiple `text` nodes containing Markdown syntax).
- Register `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` in the console browser simulation test setup via a side-effect import.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `examples/crm/src/pages/help.page.ts` | Replaces the prior `container` + multiple `text` children approach with a single `markdown` component and consolidated Markdown content. |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/BrowserSimulation.test.tsx` | Adds `import '@object-ui/plugin-markdown'` so the markdown renderer is registered during integration-style tests. |
